title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 31st July 2026 || TV5 News | TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Hold and accumulate on dip - refinery derivative chemical prices are firm; flood correction is temporary.
recommendations.detail: Sitaram invested after Gandhar Oil announced good results, but the stock corrected due to Godavari floods. Kutumba Rao said hold, and since refinery companies are doing better - derivative chemicals prices are all staying firm - and the stock has now corrected, one can accumulate between 215 and 220 for the medium term. The stock had gone from 220-230 to 280 on results before correcting.

recommendations.note: Book profits on rallies - these are dead-cat bounces; stock fell 50%+ from high and won't easily recover.
recommendations.detail: Jayamma holds Broadcom at $330 (slight profit) and SanDisk and Micron (both in loss). Kutumba Rao said book profits on rallies - these are dead-cat bounces. SanDisk has fallen more than 50% from its high, and just one or two days of 20-30% gains won't bring back the previous highs. He suggested exiting SanDisk closer to $1,400.

recommendations.note: Dead-cat bounce - stock fell 50-60% from high; exit on rallies rather than hoping for recovery.
recommendations.detail: Part of Jayamma's mail. Kutumba Rao grouped SanDisk and Micron together - both have fallen 50-60% from highs, and the current rallies are dead-cat bounces. He advised booking profits on rallies for both.
